blockingIssues.description: STT validation paths in `handlers/request-processor.ts` return plain objects cast as `Response`, so invalid-audio and empty-input branches do not produce real HTTP responses.

The live gateway path still depends on `voice-routing.ts` (1364 lines), and the newly introduced handler modules are not wired into the request flow, so the modular-structure contract and <500-line rule are not met.
The refactored response body dropped previously shipped fields (`stt_latency_ms`, `tts_generation_ms`, `tts_skipped_reason`), violating the response-format compatibility requirement.
`MAX_AUDIO_BASE64_LENGTH` is too low for exact 10MB payloads, so some valid boundary-size uploads are incorrectly rejected as `AUDIO_TOO_LARGE`.
The Sarvam STT circuit breaker opens after cumulative failures instead of the required 5 consecutive failures because success does not reset the failure count.
When the Sarvam TTS circuit breaker is open, `generateSpeech()` still falls through to OpenAI even when `providerFallbackEnabled` is false.
The completed feature commit only added tautological tests that never import or execute `generateSpeech()`, so the extraction work and required behavior were not meaningfully verified.

The completed feature commit only added non-behavioral tests that never import or execute `chatCompletion()`, `extractIntent()`, or `generateEmbedding()`, so the assigned provider work was not meaningfully implemented or verified in that feature run.
`worker_attendance` is only queried when the prompt contains a literal `YYYY-MM-DD` date, so normal attendance requests such as 'today' do not reliably access attendance data.
The attendance query is not tenant-scoped when `farmId` is omitted, allowing reads across other tenants' attendance rows for the same date.
Weather enrichment can use an arbitrary/unauthorized `farmId`, and missing coordinates fall back to hard-coded Nashik weather instead of skipping irrelevant weather context.

`decideChatRoute()` can return `farm_query`, but `handlers/main.ts` never dispatches that route to `handlers/farm-query.ts`; farm queries fall through to the advisory path instead of deterministic handling.

appliedUpdates.description: Documented the actual Supabase function secrets for Sarvam TTS speaker selection (`ASSISTANT_SARVAM_TTS_MODEL`, `ASSISTANT_SARVAM_TTS_EN_SPEAKER`, `ASSISTANT_SARVAM_TTS_HI_SPEAKER`, `ASSISTANT_SARVAM_TTS_MR_SPEAKER`, `ASSISTANT_SARVAM_TTS_PACE`) in `.factory/library/environment.md`.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require new tests to import and execute the real module under test. Tautological assertions or helper-only tests should not satisfy the tests-first requirement, and data-access work should include tenant-scope and failure-path coverage.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Reviews for be-stt-provider-upgrade, be-tts-provider, be-llm-provider, be-context-assembly, and be-routing-and-handlers all found tests that either never imported the provider/handler modules or missed critical multi-tenant/error paths.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Replace the repo-incompatible `npm test -- --grep ...` guidance with commands derived from `.factory/services.yaml` (for this repo, raw Jest plus repo-compatible filters such as `--testPathPatterns` or explicit test paths).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The be-stt-provider-upgrade review found the skill prescribing `--grep` even though this repo's canonical test command is `npx jest ...` from `.factory/services.yaml`.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Explicitly forbid piping validator commands through `tail`, `head`, or similar helpers. Workers should run the exact `.factory/services.yaml` command directly so validator exit codes are preserved.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The be-modular-structure transcript used `npm test 2>&1 | tail ...`, which can mask failing Jest exit codes.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require `skillFeedback.followedProcedure` to be false whenever documented procedure rules are violated (for example: no tests added despite tests-first claims, or module files exceeding the 500-line limit).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Reviews for be-modular-structure, be-context-assembly, and be-routing-and-handlers found `followedProcedure: true` even though no new tests were added or files exceeded the documented 500-line limit.

rejectedObservations.observation: Repeated observations that workers marked `followedProcedure: true` despite not following tests-first guidance.
The context-assembly review note that the oversize `farm-data.ts` finding is mainly a handoff-accuracy problem rather than a new shared-state rule.
The repo already documents the canonical test command in `.factory/services.yaml`.
